lines.text: Jeremiah laments being a man of strife, and the LORD promises to deliver him for a good purpose.
The LORD says your wealth will be plunder and you will be enslaved to enemies in a land unknown.
Jeremiah ate the LORD's words, which became his joy, and he sat alone away from the band of revelers.
Jeremiah asks why his pain is unending and says the LORD has become like a lion to him.
The LORD says noble words make Jeremiah His spokesman, and He will make him a fortified wall of clay.
